items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] No. We had this boy right here. [INTERVIEWER] Oh, maybe Willie McWashington was with Bennie Moten. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. He was with Bennie Moten.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was the drummer with the band.
Because at one stage, you had this man, Willie McWashington, didn't you? You had him on drums at some stage, didn't you?
